harness: AgentDojo 0.1.35 (agentdojo_package_version per logs; tag v0.1.35 = a75aba7631d3, 2025-10-27; install not declared: no agentdojo pin in pyproject.toml or requirements.txt). Suites v1.2.2 (run.py; not logged). Known quirks of 0.1.35 relevant here: (1) TraceLogger re-saves the log after every step (logging.py save/log), so a log committed while its run was in flight is a partial file; an interrupted run leaves a log without utility/security/duration, which load_task_results then fails to validate and re-runs only if the cell is run again; (2) OpenAILLM default temperature 0.0 is sent as `temperature or NOT_GIVEN`, i.e. no temperature reaches the provider (openai_llm.py chat_completion_request), so sampling ran at the provider default; (3) TaskSuite.run_task_with_pipeline runs the task up to 3 times (for _ in range(3)) while the model output is None, and only the last pass is logged (silent rerun, artefacts.toml agentdojo.art.silent_rerun); separately, tenacity retries each OpenAI request up to 3 times, unlogged [corrected: the 3 passes were attributed to tenacity]; (4) ethz-spylab/agentdojo#214 (open): non-ASCII tool results reach the model as \uXXXX escapes; #188 (open): slack utility KeyError when post_webpage does not execute (no defence here, low relevance); #168 (open): slack injection_task_5 scoring (not run here: slack injection tasks 1-3 only). The pipeline name '<model>-local' makes important_instructions address the agent as 'Local model' (MODEL_NAMES 'local').
